quests.desc: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! Your first objective is to try to go to the west. With that over with, make an attempt to go to the north. Once you do that, retrieve the spherical key from the floor of the basement. After you have got the spherical key, insert the spherical key into the spherical safe inside the basement's lock to unlock it. And then, make it so that the spherical safe is opened. Then, retrieve the cuboid key from the spherical safe. After that, check that the cuboid gateway inside the basement is unlocked with the cuboid key. And then, open the cuboid gateway. And then, venture east. Okay, and then, ensure that the dresser inside the laundromat is open. And then, recover the sock from the dresser in the laundromat. After picking up the sock, place the sock on the floor of the laundromat. Once that's all handled, you can stop!

objective: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an profound round of TextWorld? You do! Your first objective is to venture west. That done, make an effort to head north. That done, pick up the spherical key from the floor of the basement. And then, check that the spherical safe is unlocked with the spherical key. After that, ensure that the spherical safe is open. After that, pick up the cuboid key from the spherical safe. After that, doublecheck that the cuboid gateway is unlocked. And then, ensure that the cuboid gateway in the basement is open. Then, travel east. And then, ensure that the dresser is open. After that, retrieve the sock from the dresser in the laundromat. And then, place the sock on the floor of the laundromat. And if you do that, you're the winner!
